registerTime.description: Register time of invitee. Unix timestamp format in milliseconds, e.g. 1597026383085

totalTradingVolume.description: Total futures trading amount of invitee

totalTradingFee.description: Total futures trading fee of invitee

totalDeposit.description: The total deposited amount, expressed in USDT. The conversion to USDT is based on the last spot price of the deposited currency pair at the moment the deposit is credited.

totalWithdrawal.description: Total withdrawan amount, expressed in USDT. The conversion to USDT is based on the last spot price of the withdrawn currency pair at the moment the deposit is credited.

kycLevel.description: KYC level of invitee. 0 Non KYC, 1 Complete personal infomation verification, 2 Complete address proof verification

equity.description: The total equity of futures account in USDT. 0 when needEquity is false.

totalEquity.description: The total equity of all accounts in USDT. 0 when needEquity is false.

referralCode.description: Referral code that the user was invited with, e.g. 7tdIua

couponDiscount.description: The amount discounted by invitees using the coupon.

takerVol30Day.description: Taker volume in last 30 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

makerVol30Day.description: Maker volume in last 30 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

tradeVol30Day.description: Total trading volume in last 30 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

depositAmount30Day.description: Deposit amount in last 30 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

takerVol90Day.description: Taker volume in last 90 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

makerVol90Day.description: Maker volume in last 90 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

tradeVol90Day.description: Total trading volume in last 90 days (USDT), updated every six hours.

vipLevel.description: VIP level. This parameter is not displayed when requesting the list, but it will be shown when using the uid to request the invitees' details.
